outlook.statement: The presence of a stable government at the center will be a major catalyst in taking major decisions which would push forward the pace of reforms and thereby directly improving the macro-economic environment. It is now being forecasted that in the near future, the Indian economy will become the fastest growing emerging market.

Going forward, the Management remains focused on increasing revenue, improving operational performance and achieving sustainable business growth. The Company will continue to monitor market conditions and emerging opportunities and take appropriate measures to strengthen its financial performance in the coming years.

risks: Fluctuations in prices and availability of agricultural commodities, food products and chemical raw materials may impact margins and business profitability.
Changes in government regulations, export-import policies, duties, restrictions and other regulatory requirements may affect the Company's trading and export activities.
Disruptions in transportation, storage, availability of raw materials and logistics costs may adversely affect timely procurement and delivery of products.
Changes in international demand, foreign exchange rates, geopolitical conditions and global supply-chain disruptions may impact the Company's export and import-related activities.
The Company may face competition from established domestic and international players in the agricultural, food processing and chemical product segments.
Risk of loss from inadequate or failed systems, processes or procedures attributed to human failure or technical problems given the increase use of technology and staff turnover.
Estimation of useful life of property, plant and equipment, intangible assets, and investment properties may result in change in depreciation and amortization expense

Impairment of carrying value of property, plant and equipment, capital work-in-progress, intangible assets and investment properties based on estimates and assumptions regarding expected Depreciated Replacement Cost method
Estimation of current tax expenses and recognition of deferred tax assets depends upon availability of future profits
Probable outcome of matters included under contingent liabilities
Provision for doubtful debts based on Expected Credit Loss model and ageing of receivable balance
